title: Edinburgh Castle £26. Xi'an's Ming Wall: ¥54 | China Travel Expert
description:
Edinburgh Castle costs £26 to walk in — about $34. Xi'an's Ming dynasty city wall? Just ¥54, roughly $8. For one of the world's great ancient fortifications, that's a steal.

Xi'an's wall is around 650 years old (built 1370–1378) and it's the most complete ancient city wall left in China — a closed rectangle 13.74 km around. You can rent a bike up top and ride the entire loop, with the old city on one side and the moat on the other.

🧭 Expert Tip: rent a bike at the South Gate (南门) to ride the full 13.74 km loop — it's the best way to see the whole wall in one go.

爱丁堡城堡约 26 英镑，西安明城墙只要 ¥54（约 8 美元）：这段约 650 年的城墙全长 13.74 公里，是中国保存最完整的古城墙，还能骑车绕一圈。
